name: TB Debug
details: The failures are due to the implementation not producing compiled .class files in /app/bin (e.g., Position.class, Main.class), causing 'Could not find or load main class Main'. The instructions explicitly require seven Java source files in /app/src/, compilation to /app/bin with javac -source/-target 1.7, and a Main entry point runnable via 'java -cp /app/bin Main ...'. Tests are checking exactly these stated requirements, not undocumented conventions, so the issue is normal agent/implementation
